A '''stormtrooper''' was active on the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]] during [[9 BBY]]. He had an encounter with the rogue [[Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Kenobi III" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[stormtrooper]] appeared in "[[Part III]]" the third episode of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']]. He is portrayed by [[Ardeshir Radpour]].<ref name="Kenobi III" />
